content:
katie: quick heads-up 1:25am scan found a small new cluster of link issues on main. looks like mostly dead anchors in batching + a couple of images and one external shortlink. posting paths so people can claim.

docs-bot: nightly scan complete 1:27am — summary: 12 image 403s, 4 dead anchors, 2 external shortlinks. report: /tmp/scan-8432201111.json (private).

katie: problem list (fast wins):
- docs/runtime/batching.md#windowing (dead anchor)
- docs/runtime/batching.md#adaptive (dead anchor)
- docs/onboarding/quickstart.md (image ./assets/qs-curl.png -> 403)
- docs/onboarding/quickstart.md (image ./assets/qs-ux.png -> 403)
- docs/runbooks/deploy.md (diagram ../images/deploy-flow.png -> 404 in staging)
- docs/handbook/security.md (external css shortlink -> 403)

katie: prefer tiny PRs to main with brief PR body pointing to KB-305 for tracking. anyone take something?

rick: I got batching.md anchors. will add explicit heading ids and small explanatory lines so anchors resolve. quick grep then PR.

emily: i'll pick the quickstart images. if it's S3 perms i'll rehost to /static/assets/qs/ and update. can do tests for presence.

priya: i can handle the deploy diagram. question: do we have a canonical schematic repo for diagrams or should I rehost under docs/static/images?

katie: we prefer docs/static/images for runbook diagrams (keeps CDNs simple). thanks @priya.

rick: shortcut commands i'm using locally:
```
# find anchors
grep -n "^#" docs/runtime/batching.md || true
mkdocs build && linkcheck site/_site || true
```

emily: noted. i'll also add a tiny test to GH that fails if image 403 in PR preview. happy to pair with docs automation if you want.

priya: PR draft -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1450 (diagram rehost + updated path). marking ready after CI.

rick: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1451 (adds heading ids + short note). cc @katie

emily: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1452 (rehosted quickstart images under /static/assets/qs/ and added image-exists test).

katie: great. once PRs merge i'll run another full scan and then close KB-305. also filing a small follow-up to add a nightly rule that flags external shortlinks to css/js so we can triage them before they rot. posting that proposal in #eng-automation later.

priya: LGTM, will add source attribution in the PR body for the diagram.

emily: FYI re: image tests, i borrowed a tiny snippet from docs-sherpa tests, added it to our test suite so future PRs catch S3 flips.

katie: thanks all 1:45am. i'll queue reviewers and update the KB ticket after merges. :thumbsup:
